data.body: Implemented the dead Jira helper cleanup. Removed the unused Cloud _fit_description helper and retargeted the remaining prose/tests to the shared OutboundFieldMapper plus RichTextCodec composition; removed the dead _direct_rest_put issue-property wrapper and kept issue-property/reporter/unassign behavior on the concrete raw-PUT writes. Validation: focused Jira adapter/raw-PUT/rich-text suites passed; make lint and make typecheck passed; pytest -m "not integration and not external" still stops only on the pre-existing baseline test_atomic_completion_close::test_relevant_remote_rejection_never_places_candidate_on_shared_head.
